data.content_ref: inline:The category-error framing of 14e084ed5ca7 abstracts the layer-boundary distinction of 2edd20cc5e66: both share a mechanism—delivery metadata (delivery IDs, producer epochs, sequence numbers) as the invariant that enables duplicate detection—but the category-error framing collapses the writer-safety / reader-idempotency split into a single protocol-level property (distinguishability). This abstraction is refuted if the replay layer requires content-level semantics for correct deduplication (as anticipated by 14e084ed5ca7's own countercondition that distinguishability reduces to content idempotency when the replay layer ignores delivery metadata), which would force the two-layer model back into the description and show that distinguishability alone cannot replace the safety/idempotency distinction.
